name: About Modal UI
description: About modal DOM and interactions. Documents the modal overlay structure with branding header, version/naming spec rows, footer close button, Escape key dismissal, and the design.md external link.

dom.root: .modal-overlay (display:none by default, display:flex when open — covers viewport as overlay)

elements.overlay: div.modal-overlay — full-viewport overlay with click-to-dismiss (clicks on children do not dismiss)
elements.modal: div.about-modal (role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby=about-title) — centered modal card
elements.head: div.about-head > div.about-name#about-title + div.about-tagline — branding area
elements.specs: div.about-specs — container for version spec rows, each row: div.about-spec > span.about-spec-key + span.about-spec-val
elements.spec_rows: VERSION (app version from electronAPI.versions.app, fallback 'dev'), ELECTRON (major version), NODE (major version), STYLE (span.about-link#about-design-link with 'UseDesign.md' text)

interactions.name: close
interactions.trigger: click on #about-close button, OR Escape keydown, OR click on overlay background (.modal-overlay, target === overlay)
interactions.action: Set overlay display:none → remove Escape keydown listener → fire stored onClose callback → null callback

interactions.name: open_design_link
interactions.trigger: click on #about-design-link (span.about-link inside STYLE spec row)
interactions.result: Design system page opens in default browser

states.open: overlay display:flex, Escape keydown listener active, onClose callback stored
states.closed: overlay display:none, Escape keydown listener removed, onClose callback null

lifecycle.destroyed_by: Overlay remains in DOM across open/close cycles, display toggled only
